scope: Learn three-way comparison of individual ASCII digits with explicit zero-padding, using exhaustive 100 local digit pairs each update plus digit-level supervision on 4096 train number-pair records (1–4 digits). Compare native frozen digit features with byte-only control; deterministic first non-equal reduction, stable ties, explicit missing guard. No numeric comparison in learned inference. All local digit combinations are seen; generalization measured on new number pairs and unseen five-digit lengths, not unseen digits.
